reports.title: ANACON laboratory soil report — Pune project site (2017)
reports.sourcePublisher: Government of India environmental-clearance public filing repository
reports.location: Project site, Village Mann, Taluka Mulshi, Pune, Maharashtra
limitations: Public environmental laboratory report hosted in a government filing; not a government-issued agricultural Soil Health Card.
Historical reference sample from a Pune project site; not a soil measurement of the demo field or any user farm.
The complete two-page S-1 laboratory report is preserved without changing its reported values.
The report includes water-extract, available-nutrient, exchangeable-cation and digested-soil results. These methods and analyte pools must remain separate.
Printed note states 1:5 water extract, while sections separately label available nutrients and digested soil; extraction must retain this ambiguity.
Absent is a qualitative result with no stated detection limit; it must not be converted to zero.
No crop-specific laboratory interpretation bands, field sampling depth or current nutrient recommendation are supplied.
reports.retirementReason: Construction-project environmental soil report is not an agricultural-land soil reference.
